title: Ardent Uruguayan Almond Salad
description: A nutty, aerated salad infused with garlic and smoky binchotan charcoal, perfect for a romantic keto dinner.
instructions: Toast the almonds in a dry skillet over medium heat until lightly browned, about 3 minutes, then let them cool.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, binchotan charcoal powder, smoked paprika, salt and pepper until emulsified.
Add the cooled almonds, arugula, thinly sliced red onion and the toasted almonds to the dressing, tossing gently to coat.
Sprinkle a pinch of smoked paprika over the salad and give a final gentle toss.
Let the salad rest for 1 minute to allow flavors to meld.
Drizzle a splash of extra virgin olive oil over each plate before serving.
Divide the salad into two equal portions and serve immediately.
Enjoy the nutty, aerated, romantic taste of the Ardent Uruguayan Almond Salad.
